rows: THE REACTOR IS TWO SOLAR WINGS IN THE ROOM NAMED REACTOR — 12 KW NAMEPLATE, AND GENERATION IS CONDITION-BLIND BY DESIGN. LOAD IS DRAW OVER GENERATION, NOT THE SHED INDICATOR THE HUD BAR SHOWS.
STATE IS BANDED ON WORST-ROOM CO2, NOT ON SCRUBBER CAPACITY: EVERY SCRUBBER IS HEALTHY AND THE GALLEY IS STILL CLIMBING, BECAUSE FLOW ACROSS DOORS CARRIES NO DIFFUSION TERM.
THE HYDROPONICS TANK REACHED 0 L ON DAY 1.2 AND HAS NOT REFILLED. THE RECLAIMER IS HEALTHY; NOTHING IS ROUTING WATER TO THAT TANK.
MEAN GROWBED PROGRESS. BEDS SIT MID-CROP WHILE THEIR TANK IS DRY — THE FROZEN PROGRESS IS THE SYMPTOM, NOT A SEPARATE FAULT.
RADIATOR REJECTION AGAINST HEAT LOAD. THE SHIPPED OVERHEAT GUARD RULE FIRES CONSTANTLY AND ITS MESSAGE IS BACKWARDS: THE MEASURED TREND IS COLD.
POWERED OVER TOTAL INDUSTRY DEVICES. ALL THREE ANSWER AND DRAW.
A PROXY: MEAN CONDITION OVER DEVICES THAT WEAR. NO HULL-STRESS MODEL EXISTS, AND NO BREACH EVENT IS EVER PUBLISHED, SO LAST FAULT IS LEGITIMATELY BLANK.
OFFLINE BECAUSE THE DEVICE CENSUS FINDS NO TELESCOPE ABOARD. THE NAV SYSTEM IS BUILT, SAVED AND TESTED; ITS SENSOR PASS HAS NEVER RUN.
